name: BuildBot setup
description: The first-run steps: scan this computer, pick the brain, set up the vault and data folder, the Bridge, Toolsmith's model, the goal, the bot's name and look, the plan and one Yes. The steps are data; the Desktop and puffpai setup draw the same ones.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: The setup steps run on this computer. Nothing leaves your computer without your consent.

fields.label: Which brain should your bot use?
fields.help: Local models that fit this computer, strongest first. The download starts when you pick and runs while you do the next steps.

fields.label: Which model?
fields.help: An Ollama name, a GGUF file or link, or the address of a local OpenAI-compatible server.

fields.label: Where should the vault live?
fields.help: The vault holds your keys and private details, encrypted.

options.label: A drive or folder I choose

fields.label: Which folder?
fields.help: The folder that holds the vault you already have.

fields.label: Pick a PIN for your vault, at least 8 characters
fields.help: You type it to open the vault and to say Yes to the biggest steps.

fields.label: Type your PIN again
fields.help: So a typo can't lock you out of your own vault.

fields.label: Your data folder
fields.help: The ONE folder for your bot's own data. Books and downloads go with it unless you pick another place next.

fields.label: Where should books and downloads go?
fields.help: An offline library can run to 100 GB, so it may suit another drive.

fields.label: Link folders you already have (optional)
fields.help: Folders are read where they are, never copied or changed. Put a ; between folders.

fields.label: While Toolsmith builds, may it search?
fields.help: The Bridge is closed. Nothing leaves your computer without your consent.

options.label: Let Toolsmith search for apps and knowledge while it builds: GitHub, Codeberg, npm, PyPI, the MCP server list, HACS, ClawHub, skills.sh, the Hermes skills index, Hugging Face, Kiwix and Data.gov
options.note: Recommended for a first build. It sends search words like "world news map", nothing else.

options.label: Keep it closed; I'll add things myself

fields.label: Which model should Toolsmith use?
fields.help: Toolsmith installs apps. It uses the brain on this computer.

options.label: Use a cloud model for Toolsmith only

fields.label: Do you agree to send this?
Paste your key
fields.help: It goes into your vault. Nothing is sent to the company before you say Yes to a plan.

fields.label: Cost cap for each build, in US dollars
fields.help: Toolsmith pauses and asks before it goes over.

fields.label: Your GitHub key (optional)
fields.help: A personal access token from github.com. It lets Toolsmith search GitHub more: 30 searches a minute instead of 10. It stays in your vault, and only Toolsmith's GitHub searches use it. You can add it later on the Developer page.

fields.label: What do you want your bot to do?
fields.help: Say it in your own words. For example: a garden helper for my vegetable beds, or a bot that knows every dinosaur.
fields.examples: A meal helper for our family: plan dinners for the week, make the shopping list, and find recipes for what is already in the fridge.

fields.label: What should your bot be called?
fields.help: Pick one of the names below, or type your own. Up to 40 characters.

fields.label: Which look should your Desktop wear?
fields.help: You can change it later in Looks.

fields.label: Use a project you know (optional): paste a GitHub address
Use an app already on your bot? Nothing is ticked unless you pick it.
